definitions.explanation: A cabinet or boxlike piece of furniture for storing books.

examples.japanese: {本箱|ほんばこ}に{本|ほん}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: I arrange books in the bookcase.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{本箱|ほんばこ}が{本|ほん}でいっぱいだ。
examples.english: The old bookcase is full of books.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しのとき、{本箱|ほんばこ}の{本|ほん}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{段|だん}ボールに{詰|つ}め{直|なお}した。
examples.english: When I moved, I repacked all the books from the bookcase into cardboard boxes.

notes:
A cabinet or shelving unit for storing books. Slightly old-fashioned; {本棚|ほんだな} is the more common word in everyday speech today.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本箱|ほんばこ}にしまう: to put away in the bookcase
- {本箱|ほんばこ}から{取|と}り{出|だ}す: to take out of the bookcase
- {本箱|ほんばこ}を{整理|せいり}する: to tidy the bookcase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本棚|ほんだな}: bookshelf — the most common modern word; typically open shelving
- {書棚|しょだな}: bookshelf — slightly more formal or literary than {本棚|ほんだな}
